plan.rationale: The frozen objective is latency_ms of one complete offline batch=32 FP32 ResNet-18 forward under torch.inference_mode(), bounded by torch.cuda.synchronize() on both sides (resnet_inference.py:42-47), with exact-top1 and 1e-4 logits quality checks. torch already ran and is retained as the attribution source of record: coverage shows 88 CUDA kernels with 88/88 associated to project calls, 0 unassociated, 0 ambiguous forward sequences and 0 autograd/backward ranges, so per-operator GPU attribution is complete; the source contains no CUDA graphs and the task is single-stream on one device, leaving no overlap, graph-tracing or attribution question that would justify an additional nsys run. The task is single-device (request.devices lists one GPU, distributed_backend null), the communication capability is observed not_applicable and the trace contains no NCCL kernels, so nccl_tuning, collective_calibration and device_telemetry are not applicable; device-wide NVML PCIe/utilization/memory windows could not attribute per-kernel latency regardless, inputs are GPU-resident, and host transfer sits outside the measured unit. The remaining open question for minimizing the synchronized wall window is whether it is GPU-busy or contains host dispatch dead time across the 88 kernel launches, and which host call paths dominate dispatch/binding cost (transformers ResNet module traversal). execution_timeline is selected to record, in a separate plain Torch trace, CPU-to-CUDA submit associations with enqueue-to-start intervals, cuda synchronization events, per-device kernel intervals and copies/memsets; its clock-alignment bounds cover matching CPU submissions only, GPU readiness and consumer completion may remain unknown, and it never replaces a communication hook or determines subsequent search actions. python_runtime is selected to locate host dispatch and binding costs via a separate warmed cProfile call trace; it perturbs execution and its inclusive/self times are not clean performance scores or GPU compute durations, so it is diagnostic only and cannot substitute for the frozen objective measurement. candidate_diagnostics and binding_cost are inapplicable because no candidate exists at initial planning, hence revision is null. No PCIe/NVLink traffic is invented from logical payload or memcpy sizes, and no gradient bucket identity exists in an inference-only workload; nsys timelines would add nothing beyond the already-complete torch attribution.
